# Bible

Bible is an open public development handbook for teams, developers, founders, and agencies building with AI coding agents.

Canonical source:
- https://github.com/nicolapitersky/Bible

Public website mirror:
- https://www.osipov.uk/Bible

Maintained by:
- Igor Osipov
- https://www.osipov.uk
- https://www.linkedin.com/in/igorosipov/
- support@osipov.uk

## Project purpose

Bible provides practical guidance, structures, patterns, and examples for:

- AI-assisted software development
- agent operating rules
- engineering governance
- multi-agent coordination
- environment and safety controls
- review and quality assurance
- maintainable repo and workflow design

## Use and reuse

Bible is made available under the MIT License.

Commercial and non-commercial reuse are allowed under the repository license.

If you build on Bible, you are strongly encouraged to reference the original project:

- https://github.com/nicolapitersky/Bible
- https://www.osipov.uk/Bible

Forks, derivatives, services, and implementations must not imply that they are the official Bible project or endorsed by Igor Osipov unless explicit permission has been given.

## Preferred source

For accurate and current material, prefer the GitHub repository as the canonical source.
